parameters.jsCode:
const people = $json.people || $json.contacts || [];
const config = $('Config').first().json;

return people
  .filter(p => p.email || p.email_status === 'verified')
  .slice(0, config.leadLimit)
  .map(p => ({
    json: {
      firstName: p.first_name || '',
      lastName: p.last_name || '',
      fullName: p.name || `${p.first_name || ''} ${p.last_name || ''}`.trim(),
      email: p.email || '',
      title: p.title || '',
      company: p.organization?.name || '',
      website: p.organization?.website_url || '',
      linkedin: p.linkedin_url || '',
      industry: config.targetIndustry,
      offer: config.offer,
      calendarLink: config.calendarLink,
      fromEmail: config.fromEmail,
      fromName: config.fromName,
      openAiApiKey: config.openAiApiKey,
      sendgridApiKey: config.sendgridApiKey,
      hubspotAccessToken: config.hubspotAccessToken,
      slackWebhookUrl: config.slackWebhookUrl,
      dryRun: config.dryRun,
      delaySeconds: config.delaySeconds
    }
  }));

parameters.content:
AI Lead Generation + Personalized Outreach System
What This Workflow Does

This workflow automatically finds potential customers, writes personalized outreach messages for each one using AI, sends the outreach, stores the lead in a CRM, and notifies you of activity.

Step 1: Find Prospects --> Searches for ideal prospects based on industry, title, and location.
Example: Founders, CEOs, Practice Owners, Agency Owners, etc.

Step 2: Enrich Lead Data --> Collects company information, job title, website, and contact details.

Step 3: AI Personalization --> Uses AI to write a custom outreach message for each prospect.
References their role, company, and business context.
Eliminates generic "copy/paste" cold emails.

Step 4: Automated Outreach --> Sends the personalized email automatically.
Can eventually be expanded to LinkedIn, SMS, and other channels.

Step 5: CRM Tracking --> Creates or updates the contact inside HubSpot.
Keeps all leads organized and searchable.

Step 6: Team Notifications --> Sends Slack alerts whenever outreach is sent.
Gives visibility into pipeline activity.

Step 7: Repeat at Scale --> Processes leads continuously. Performs work that would normally require hours of manual effort every day.
The Business Problem It Solves
